title: EasyDiffraction
description:
EasyDiffraction is software for analysing powder and single-crystal diffraction data from neutron and X-ray instruments: calculating patterns from a structural model and fitting the model to the data, including magnetic structures. It comes as a desktop and web application, a Python package and a command line, all built on the same calculation engine.

Release notes: github.com/enhantica/edi/releases. Documentation: easydiffraction.org.
